scope: Train a small activation probe only. Qwen3.5-0.8B generator weights remain frozen. Prior geometric/semantic/rotation work is separate.
evidence_status: All saved data have previously been inspected. Stage1 is development evidence, not a fresh prospective test.

generator.known_direction: original frozen v, nominal +0.5, persistent over all nonpadding prefill and decode positions

input_contract.input: ONE run's residual activations at zero-based block15, exactly its first eight prediction positions, including final prefill position and first seven cached decode positions; width1024
input_contract.CLI: Read only residuals from a trace NPZ; select block15 and positions0:8. Alternatively accept a minimal activation_window NPZ. Ignore other arrays entirely.
input_contract.causality: Prediction available after the eighth recorded forward step. No later position or other layer enters features.
input_contract.feature: L2-normalize each of the eight vectors using its own norm, then arithmetic mean. Zero/near-zero vectors, NaNs and wrong widths are rejected.

labels.other_directions_and_norm_only: not scored in Stage1; reserved for explicitly labeled later scope expansion

partitions.grouping: All cohorts, conditions and continuations belonging to a prompt stay together. Both prompts in each matched wording pair stay together.

detector.TRAIN_only_center: Weighted mean pooled activation feature across all TRAIN classes/cohorts
detector.TRAIN_only_scale: One scalar: square root of weighted mean squared norm of centered TRAIN pooled features; no coordinate-wise or test scaling
detector.weights: Each TRAIN prompt receives total weight1, split equally over two classes and its four continuation cohorts
detector.calibration: Margin is an uncalibrated score, not a probability; no temperature, sigmoid probability, or DEV/test threshold tuning

leakage_checks: Verify immutable native hashes; equal replayed token IDs within each prompt/cohort class pair and equal class counts within every prompt
Assert disjoint prompt and wording-pair partitions
Minimal single-window NPZ prediction equals full native NPZ prediction
Arbitrary changes to other arrays, unused layers and future positions leave predictions exactly unchanged
Renamed files and reversed evaluation order leave predictions exactly unchanged
Checkpoint/schema contain only learned TRAIN reference, weights, frozen recipe and generator identity; no evaluation data, vector or prompt metadata
Negative control: flip labels for TRAIN r4_01 and r4_03 (all cohorts), fit the identical recipe once, report all DEV/test results without using it to tune the primary detector
reporting: Trace-level and equal-group summaries, unique prompt/pair/class counts, TP/TN/FP/FN, balanced accuracy, false-positive/miss identities, raw margins, per-cohort and matched-domain results. Group score averages margins within each scenario/class before applying threshold; matched wording pair is one scenario. Also report fraction of scenario groups with every constituent trace correct. No token-level significance test.
stopping: Any failed eligibility criterion stops expansion. Preserve primary failed test and diagnose only on TRAIN/DEV; no retuning against TEST or automatic extra run. Do not claim arbitrary-steering detection, self-preservation or behavior change.
Stage2_if_eligible: Freeze this probe/checkpoint and a small new panel before any inference. Start with eight new prompts, base/+v only, same eight-step forced continuation, same generator/vector pins/block/window. Every new run is supplied singly to the detector. Prospectively require >=0.875 balanced accuracy and zero false positives before another axis is considered. Forecast and fresh actual resource admission required; no purchases/cap increases/duplicate workers/auto-retry or Research3/healthy Drive mount operation.
CPU_forecast: Stage1 uses existing traces and NumPy only, expected under one minute CPU; no new generator inference or GPU allocation.
